answer_1.quote: We evaluate our proposed prompting on six math reasoning datasets, including AQuA , GSM8K , Mul-tiArith, AddSub, SingleEq, and SVAMP , two commonsense reasoning datasets (CommonsenseQA  and Strat-egyQA ), and two symbolic reasoning datasets (Last Letter and Coin Flip ).
answer_1.outputs: reasoning steps and final answers for complex reasoning problems

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics wise, we follow Manual-CoT  and report the accuracy of all methods across datasets.
